name: Production hazırlama ve çok süreç dayanıklılığı

durabilityMatrix.description: Child process A compiles and publishes; child process B reads from cold disk storage with zero RAM sharing
Process killed via SIGKILL during staging write does not leak corrupted scenes to published directory
Publish attempt with stale fence token or cancelled status is rejected and staging directory is purged
Job with empty or missing buffer transitions to failed status immediately without hanging in running state
Deleting sole view session cancels job and increments fence token; multi-observer jobs stay running until last observer leaves
Returns HTTP 409 SOURCE_REVISION_CHANGED when expectedSourceVersionKey does not match authoritative revision
Rejects arbitrary client-supplied accessUrl targeting metadata services, localhost, or foreign hosts
isValidCadV2StorageId rejects directory traversal attempts (dot-dot, slashes, null bytes) across all endpoints
Enforces 180s TTL contract; expired sessions return HTTP 410 VIEW_SESSION_EXPIRED; DELETE returns 204
Enforces 401 unauthenticated, 403 forbidden, and 410 expired/revoked share token access controls
